about.title: Corcoran Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything overnight, and the practical questions — funeral costs, lost income, what happens next — often arrive before anyone has had time to grieve. Corcoran's public-record crash data shows collisions along corridors like Whitley Avenue, Rt 43, Dairy Avenue, and Orange Avenue, with reported activity tending to peak on Thursday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Any one of these could turn fatal, leaving a spouse, domestic partner, or children to sort through loss and liability at once. California law gives certain family members and dependents standing to pursue a wrongful death claim, but the timeline is strict and the details matter. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect Corcoran families with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain the options, free of charge and without obligation.

whyChoose.title: What Matters in a California Wrongful Death Claim

items.title: Only Certain Family Members Can File
items.desc: California law limits standing to a spouse, domestic partner, and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in some cases. An attorney can clarify who in your family qualifies before any claim moves forward.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Two Years — Sometimes Less
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but that window shrinks significantly if a government entity (like a public roadway agency) may be involved. Acting early preserves options.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Funeral Bill
items.desc: California allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, but also for lost financial support and the loss of a loved one's love, companionship, and guidance. A civil case is separate from any criminal charges the driver may face.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the circumstances. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and confirm who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Corcoran?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. That deadline can be much shorter if a government entity, such as one responsible for a road like Rt 43 or Orange Avenue, may share responsibility. Speaking with an attorney sooner rather than later helps protect your family's rights.

items.question: Can we still bring a civil claim if criminal charges are filed against the driver?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil matter from any criminal prosecution, and the two proceed independently under California law. Even if criminal charges are pending or resolved, your family may still pursue compensation through a civil case.

items.question: What kinds of losses can a wrongful death claim cover?
items.answer: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. There's no fixed dollar figure — every family's situation is different, and an attorney can walk through what applies to yours.
